nodes.n: 6 AM. Imran is strapping his shin with three rolls of tape. He won't look at you.

choice.t: Tell Kabir Sir about the shin.
choice.d: Save his career. Lose his trust.

choice.t: Pay for a private scan in town tonight.
choice.d: Find out the truth without anyone knowing.

nodes.th: It's his career. I'll keep my mouth shut. And my eyes open.

nodes.t: Hairline fracture. Two more days of bowling and it would have snapped. Six weeks rest. He'll bowl again.
You did the hard thing. Don't expect him to thank you this year.

nodes.n: A small clinic above a pharmacy in Indiranagar. 11 PM. Cash. No names.

nodes.t: Bone bruise. Not a fracture. Two days of ice and I'm fine.
Bhai. I don't... nobody's ever... Amma will pray for you every day for the rest of your life. Sorry in advance.

nodes.n: 11 AM. A helicopter's worth of noise outside the gates. Phones go up. Even Kabir Sir puts down his stopwatch.
Karan Dhillon. National captain. Eleven years, nine thousand runs, one smile the whole country recognises.

nodes.t: Relax, everyone. I'm only here to watch the intra-squad game. And steal Kabir bhai's lunch.
You. The Rajgarh kid. I watched your PCL final three times.
Didn't matter that you lost. You walked off like you'd won. That's rarer.
That six over midwicket. My son made me rewind it until the remote broke.

choice.t: "Can I get a selfie? For my sister."
choice.d: Pinky will never forgive you otherwise.

nodes.t: Intra-squad game. They've put me on to bowl the last over at you. Fate, chaiwala.
Last over, they've given me the ball against you. Nothing personal. I'm still going to try to take your head off.

moment.title: 9 off 6
moment.desc: Intra-squad game. Vikrant Chauhan with the ball. The national captain on the boundary. Nine to win.

nodes.t: Kabir bhai. I want him in my nets tomorrow.
He's not on the squad yet, Karan.
That's why I said nets, not dinner.
Close. Close doesn't get on the plane.
Hey. Your bat came down straight under pressure. That's the bit you can't teach.

nodes.n: Midnight. You left your bat in the dressing room. The stadium tunnel is lit by one flickering tube light.
A voice at the far end. Low. Shaking.

nodes.t: I said I'll pay. All of it. Just keep my family out of this. Please.

nodes.n: He turns. He sees you. For a second, the most famous face in the country looks terrified.

nodes.t: ...Go to sleep, champ. You didn't see anything.

nodes.cliff: The national captain is being blackmailed. And now he knows that you know.
